description: Set the inventory sync mode (none | pull | push | both) for one mapped Shopify location. The effective inventory flow is the store-level switch AND the location mode — e.g. pushInventory on the store plus a 'pull' location means nothing is pushed for that location. A location must be mapped to a Spark warehouse before any mode other than 'none' applies; order routing is independent of this setting. All other settings are preserved. Returns the store's fresh configuration. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token with write access.

shopifyLocationId.description: The Shopify location id, as returned by get_shopify_store_settings.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: The store the location belongs to (e.g. 'my-store.myshopify.com'). Optional when exactly one store is configured.

syncMode.description: Inventory sync direction: none | pull | push | both.

name: set_shopify_location_sync_mode
title: Set Shopify Location Sync Mode
